apply_to: a COPY of the workbook only; never the real one
how_to_measure: On the copy: write one cell (or one row) with values.update / batchUpdate, then immediately values.get a dependent cell (e.g. 'F1/F2_MutationRate'!A2) and time how long the read takes to return; reads wait for the recalculation. Repeat each scenario 3x before and after each change. Scenarios: (S1) type a new reared individual into an existing pre-made Insectary_data row (B..AC); (S2) change one Insectary_data P (CAM_ID); (S3) change one Insectary_data B (Wild_Reared); (S4) change one Insectary_data C (CLUTCH NUMBER); (S5) append one row to Photo_links (B,E); (S6) change one Collection_data D (Insectary_ID).
how_to_check_identical: Before any change, export every sheet with values.batchGet valueRenderOption=UNFORMATTED_VALUE and again with FORMATTED_VALUE. After each change, export again and diff cell by cell over all sheets (not only the edited one: pivots and other sheets depend on these columns). Expected diff: none, except the new helper columns of change C1 and the removed rows of C5. Errors compare by their code (#N/A, #REF!).
per_cell_rule: Several columns are not uniform (copy/paste bugs: rows whose key points at another column or at #REF!). Rewrite each cell from its OWN formula with the transform below, keeping its own references. Leave unchanged any cell whose formula contains #REF! or does not match the old pattern, and list it.

changes.transform: In each target cell, replace every XLOOKUP(<key>, <lookup_range>, <result_col>, <not_found>) whose <key> is a same-row reference to a key column served by a helper (D, G, J, M, P, S, V over Insectary_data!A:A; D over Collection_data!D:D; AB over Insectary_data!P:P) with IF(ISNUMBER($<helper><row>),INDEX(<result_col>,$<helper><row>),<not_found>). Choose the helper by the key column the cell actually uses (row 12's H uses M12, so it maps to BI, not BG). Only rewrite when the formula tests that same key for "" before reaching the XLOOKUP (true for every observed pattern); otherwise leave the cell.

changes.out_of_scope_here: AP:AU (lookups into the dated snapshots Ithomiini_tube_locations_18Jun26 / MEIER_manifests_30Jan25_OLD, which do not change); leave them.
changes.expected_gain: ~33 whole-column scans per row become 9 helper scans, and the helpers only rescan when their key column changes (Insectary_data A or P, Collection_data D). Model: S2 (P edit) 274M -> ~25M cell reads; S3 (B edit) 372M upper bound -> ~0 (INDEX only); a typical save that leaves Insectary_data A alone 556M -> ~100M.
changes.risks: Checks to make on the copy: (1) blank results come back the same (INDEX of an empty cell vs XLOOKUP of an empty cell); (2) a key that is an error keeps erroring the same way. Rows sorted or inserted keep their helpers, since the helpers live in the same row. The app's own formula evaluator (server/formula.mjs) doesn't know XMATCH, so for these cells it shows the sheet's value. The app reports new headers as 'columna nueva ... (ignorada)', which does no harm.
changes.why_pas: Columns A, E:F, H:I, K:L, N, Q:R, T:U, W, AB, AD:AL are protected owner-only; adding columns to the sheet is his call
